feature_semantics.fuel: Literal structured pre-КПП fuel takes precedence; unknown is explicit. Five narrative dual-fuel/structured-petrol disagreements (including one spaced em dash) retain petrol and receive dual_fuel_claim/fuel_text_conflict flags.
feature_semantics.engine: Electric without a positive literal displacement is 0 L plus engine_not_applicable=1. Electric with positive reported displacement retains the reported valid value and gets engine_source_conflict=1. Invalid/missing combustion displacement stays NaN plus engine_missing=1.
feature_semantics.claims: Positive text claims only, with local negation rejected; zero means not positively stated, not verified absence. Trim tokens describe seller wording, not authenticated trim.
feature_semantics.power: Explicit unit required: Russian л.с./лс uses metric horsepower ×0.73549875; hp/bhp uses ×0.745699872; kW unchanged. Conflicting values remain missing; no inferred model specifications.
feature_semantics.inputs: Only existing title/specification/description and original vehicle columns; no price, price_raw, listing ID or URL predictors.

data.target: advertised asking price of used cars
data.preprocessing: Enhanced train-fitted numeric imputation/scaling and categorical unknown/OHE. OHE threshold selected on train CV or validation for ANN. CatBoost consumes native categories; legacy controls use unchanged legacy_data.py.

plots.interpretation: Training mean price 9.53m exceeds median 6.70m KZT, indicating a high-price tail.
Newer model years generally have higher median asking prices. Year-price association does not establish causality; displayed years require at least eight training listings.
Higher observed mileage is associated with lower asking prices, with substantial spread. The chart uses a seeded sample of up to 1200 training rows with known mileage.

Fuel groups have different price distributions, but also different vehicle mixes. All training rows are retained; logarithmic price scale and group counts are explicit. Electric and hybrid groups are small, so group price gaps are descriptive, not causal.

eda.fit_scope: Training listings only; four explicit EDA plots, each with an interpretation.

supervised.cv_protocol: 3-fold KFold, shuffle=True, seed 42, within training only
supervised.midterm_cv_note: Original tree used unshuffled 3-fold CV. New searches use one shared shuffled CV.
supervised.representation: Four original baselines use unchanged legacy_data.py. Tuned models use corrected/enriched inputs; OHE min_frequency 1/2/5 is selected inside CV.

catboost.architecture: Additive gradient boosting of symmetric decision trees; native categorical statistics, no one-hot preprocessing.

preprocessing.numeric: float64; genuine missing numeric values remain NaN and are handled by CatBoost
preprocessing.categorical: missing values become __missing__; all categories cast to strings; saved training column order retained
preprocessing.learned_transform_fit_split: each CV training fold; final fit uses training only

catboost.target_transform: log1p(price_KZT); predict max(0, expm1(predicted_log_price)); no target scaler; log clipped only for numerical safety

cv.fit_split: training only; fold validation controls each fit's early stopping
cv.selection_metric: mean fold MAE in original KZT; standard deviation uses ddof=0
cv.tie_breaking: first candidate in raw MAE then log RMSE, each depth 4/6/8

catboost.final_fit: training observations only; external validation selects the best MAE-in-KZT checkpoint with patience 60 and at most 1000 iterations
catboost.history_metric_precision: CatBoost evaluates its internally rounded target buffers; inverse-log history metrics can differ by a few KZT from exact original-label errors. Reported CV scores and final validation MAE are recomputed against original KZT targets.
catboost.global_model_selection: Caller compares this final validation MAE with other model families before retrospective test evaluation.

ensemble.selection: Lowest validation MAE among predeclared pairs and weights; no fitting on test

robust_ann.target_transform: Training-standardized log1p KZT; ANNRegressor converts predictions back to finite nonnegative KZT.
robust_ann.aggregation: Equal arithmetic mean of every fixed seed; no seed subsets are searched.

dataset_enrichment.fitted_transforms: None in this export. Model imputers, indicators, scalers and encoders must be fitted within the training fold.
dataset_enrichment.model_status: This export does not fit or select a model. Actual field usage and model metrics are recorded in the project README and results/report.json; candidate status does not mean every extra field is enabled.
dataset_enrichment.source_limits: Capped seller descriptions; unmentioned fields are unknown. Literal claims are not verified vehicle facts. No external specs, new ads, synthetic rows, price changes or target-based exclusions.

preprocessing.fit_scope: training listings only; no validation or test listings
preprocessing.scaler: StandardScaler: subtract training mean and divide by training population standard deviation

unsupervised.selection_rule: Highest training silhouette over k=2..8; exact ties choose smaller k.
unsupervised.profile_definition: Cluster medians use observed original values; missing values are excluded, with observed counts reported. Price is added only after fitting for descriptive comparison.
unsupervised.centroid_definition: Centroids are means in scaled, imputed numeric space. The original-space table inverses scaling; expm1(log-mileage centroid) is not the arithmetic mean or median mileage.

pca.input: The same train-imputed and train-standardized three numeric features as KMeans.
pca.loading_definition: Signed unit-length component coefficients (sklearn PCA.components_); not feature-component correlations. Component signs are arbitrary.

interpretation: Categories are deliberately omitted so the three numeric axes remain interpretable; brand, model and equipment differences are not represented.
Silhouette is a geometric heuristic in this chosen standardized feature space; the winning k does not establish natural market segments or universal optimality.
PCA is descriptive dimensionality reduction, not a supervised predictor or evidence of causal effects on price.
The two-dimensional chart loses the variance in PC3; separation in the projection can differ from separation in all three dimensions.
Median imputation and a single seed can influence clustering; no cluster stability study is claimed.
Post-hoc price differences are descriptive asking-price summaries; price never enters clustering or PCA.
unsupervised.analysis_subset: Non-electric training listings only; engine displacement is not applicable to explicit electric listings.

evaluation.selection_metric: Each follow-up requires strictly lower validation MAE and higher within ±20% than its preceding retained ensemble; then minimize equal-weight normalized MAE and miss fraction.
evaluation.test_policy: Historical test errors motivated feature-engineering hypotheses. Parameters/checkpoints are selected using train CV/validation only. This reused test is retrospective and cannot establish independent generalization of the improvements.
evaluation.follow_up: First preserve the frozen steering pool control; then test only the TRAIN-OOF-supported age/usage pair with two checkpoints and 12 fixed pool/reference mixtures. No further test-guided tuning.

error_analysis.residual_sign: actual minus prediction; positive means underestimation

evaluation.historical_test_disclosure: Historical test errors motivated feature-engineering hypotheses. Parameters/checkpoints are selected using train CV/validation only. This reused test is retrospective and cannot establish independent generalization of the improvements.
evaluation.uncertainty: Engineering was motivated by known benchmark errors; all reported benchmark gains need independent later-data confirmation. One split and sparse high-price/rare-model segments limit conclusions.
